_docs: Manual video list for platforms without a usable public API (TikTok, Instagram, X) — and optional extra YouTube/Twitch entries. Fields: platform (tiktok|instagram|x|youtube|twitch), url (required), title (required), thumbnail (optional), published_at (optional ISO date). The current entries are REAL videos from Steam's official YouTube channel, added as demo content — replace them with your own.
